Decimal literals of om/encoder/bw_enc_sm121.om (Omega takes decimal only) and their hex values.
Every decimal literal of 3+ digits outside note lines was converted by the Wolfram Language evaluator (MCP),
2026-10-27; the hex is what src/omega_blackwell_codegen.c encode_single_insn writes. Byte identity of the
emitted code is proven separately by make test-om-encoder / test-om-encoder-corpus, not by this table.

Query: StringRiffle[Map[ToString[#] <> "=0x" <> IntegerString[#, 16] &, {<literals>}], "\n"]
Further single queries: FromDigits["fca00",16] -> 1034752; BitAnd[16^^7986, BitNot[16^^f000]] -> 2438
(STG.STRONG.SYS with p0 clears the predicate nibble before OR-ing the predicate); 2^32-1 -> 4294967295;
1024*16 -> 16384; 1024*8 -> 8192; 256+32 -> 288.
